description: Delhivery reported a 65% year-on-year decline in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 31.9 crore, despite a 28% rise in revenue to Rs 2,930.7 crore. EBITDA fell 4% as higher labour, fuel and operating costs weighed on margins. The logistics company expects pricing revisions and revenue growth to offset cost pressures.

title: India's resilient economy to support markets but global risks remain elevated: Sebi
description: India's financial markets are poised for growth, buoyed by robust domestic economic fundamentals like strong consumer demand and proactive government spending. Nevertheless, international geopolitical tensions and fluctuating commodity prices present daunting challenges. Consequently, there may be fluctuations in foreign capital inflows, which could affect market stability. Nonetheless, SEBI remains optimistic about India's potential to outperform globally, despite these external challenges.

title: Foreign flows into Indian bonds may remain muted despite tax relief: SBI Funds
description: Foreign investment in Indian government bonds is projected to stay subdued as global yields alongside domestic interest rates reduce investor attraction. The postponement of India's inclusion in global bond indices further curbs foreign portfolio investments. The Reserve Bank of India is anticipated to keep interest rates steady for a considerable duration, with heightened global yields providing minimal support to local interest rates.

title: Apollo Micro Systems Q1 Results: Firm posts record June-quarter profit at Rs 25 crore; revenue surges 88% YoY
description: Apollo Micro Systems reported a 43% year-on-year rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 25.2 crore, while revenue surged 88% to Rs 251.3 crore. EBITDA rose 18% to Rs 48 crore, though margins moderated. The defence company said its best-ever first-quarter performance reflects strong execution and continued sector demand.

title: Blackstone's AGS Health files updated draft papers for $500 million India IPO
description: In a significant move, AGS Health, operating under Blackstone, has filed revised draft documents for its upcoming IPO in India, which is projected at 48 billion rupees. This offering features a new share release, as Blackstone aims to divest shares worth 30 billion rupees. Notably, AGS Health, known for its revenue cycle management services for U.S. hospitals, achieved a profit of 2.07 billion rupees last fiscal year.

title: Sumadhura Group to invest Rs 2,000 cr on construction of housing project in Bengaluru
description: Sumadhura Group plans to invest Rs 2,000 crore in an ambitious new housing project spanning 17 acres in Bengaluru's Whitefield-Kannamangala Corridor. This development aims to deliver an impressive 2.5 million square feet of residential space. With a strong pipeline exceeding 40 million square feet, this project underscores the robust growth opportunities in East Bengaluru.

title: US Treasury yields fall as jobs report dashes hike bets
description: U.S. Treasury yields saw a drop on Friday following an unexpected decline in July's job numbers. Traders subsequently lowered their predictions for an interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve in the upcoming September meeting. While the unemployment rate dipped, labor participation faced a decline, coupled with slower wage increases. This shift in the jobs market could indicate a shift towards a more dovish stance from the Federal Reserve.

title: Explained: How BSE traded fewer contracts after CAS but premiums rose 75% in first week
description: BSE’s derivatives activity fell sharply in the first week of the Closing Auction Session, but higher premiums more than offset the decline in contracts. Premium per contract surged 74.8%, lifting average daily premium turnover 21.3% and pushing BSE’s market share to 37.1%, according to Nuvama Institutional Equities.

title: Bitcoin hovers near $65,000 as key resistance caps further upside; Ethereum gains momentum
description: Bitcoin hovered near $65,000 as resistance around $65,000–$65,600 capped further gains, while Ethereum showed stronger momentum above $1,900. Analysts said improving macro conditions are supportive for risk assets, but technical confirmation remains crucial. Crypto ETFs also saw steady inflows, signalling continued institutional demand despite mixed risk sentiment.
